annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: to reassess a case is to evaluate or appraise it a second time.

annotation.surface: God, worn out after creating the world, bringing in the Sabbath to rest.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface recalls Genesis, where God rests on the seventh day; 'energy exhausted' looks like one idea but gives GO and DEAD.
annotation.definitionFit: The Godhead is the divine nature of God, the maker of heaven and earth.
